ignorePatterns:
node_modules/**
dist/**
build/**
.next/**
out/**
tmp/**
scratch/**
bun.lock
package-lock.json
pnpm-lock.yaml
yarn.lock
**/*.lock
instructions: Greenfield TypeScript/Bun project. Skip style/formatting nits (handled by Biome). Focus on correctness, security, and maintainability. Do NOT suggest backward-compatibility shims.

rules.rule: Avoid `any`. Use `unknown` + type narrowing for untyped boundaries.
Configuration display, logs, and error messages must redact keys, tokens, and credentials.
Greenfield project. Reject suggestions to add backward-compatibility shims, legacy code paths, or deprecation warnings.
Avoid swallowed catches. Errors should be logged or rethrown with context, not silently ignored.
